notes.text: Ethan started coming to high school student night. Quiet at first, but he is already helping with sound.
notes.testPurpose: A note on a child written more than two years ago.

notes.author: alisha
notes.text: Grace signed up for midweek student night and brought her own Bible, with notes in the margins.

notes.text: Talked with Ethan about plans after graduation. He is weighing Palo Verde Technical College and an apprenticeship. Invited him to the senior send-off.
